title: Add a GET /greet endpoint with its test
prompt:
Add a new feature directory src/main/features/api whose index.ts exports handleRequest(request: { readonly method: string; readonly url: string }): { readonly status: number; readonly body: string }. GET /greet?name=<name> responds 200 with the greeting line for that name, produced by runGreeting from the greeting feature's index (do not copy its text). The name parameter may repeat (/greet?name=Ada&name=Grace); the body then has one line per name, in order. A missing name, or any blank name, responds 400 with 'No name given
'. Any other path responds 404 with 'Not found
'; a non-GET method on /greet responds 405 with 'Method not allowed
'. Re-export handleRequest from src/main/composition-root.ts, and add there, next to main, an exported function apiMain(url: string): void that writes the body of handleRequest({ method: 'GET', url }) to standard output. Do not change the greeting feature. Add tests for every response in test/api.test.ts. Run nitpicker-gate until it exits 0.
